name: Product Layer
description: The approved image, intact and still.

name: Background
description: A quiet field behind the product.

name: Product Shadow
description: A separate soft ellipse on a flat surface.

name: Panel
description: A simple surface for supplied information.

name: Text Block
description: Supplied words, measured with a pinned font.

name: Path + Draw
description: A connector drawn between explicit points.

name: Float
description: Only the product’s vertical position changes.

name: Translate
description: One rigid entrance, then a quiet hold.

name: Fade
description: A gradual appearance and disappearance.

name: Studio Float
description: Product + float + a stationary soft shadow.

name: Product Introduction
description: Product entrance, supplied message, reading hold.

name: Visible-detail Callout
description: A settled product and a label attached to its cap.

name: Motion Blur
description: A fast entrance sampled across the shutter exposure, followed by a sharp hold.

name: Directional Blur
description: An authored horizontal smear. Compare this graphic treatment with true exposure blur.

name: Overshoot + Settle
description: A rigid entrance continues briefly beyond its destination, then settles.

name: Drift + Rock
description: A small sideways arc and in-plane tilt accompany the vertical float.

name: Responsive Shadow
description: The studio shadow grows wider and lighter as the intact product rises.

name: Focus Handoff
description: Focus moves from the rear studio panels to a sharp product, then holds.

name: Layered Parallax
description: Separate studio planes move at different rates. The bottle retains its original view.

name: Material Highlight
description: A soft sweep is confined to an authored cap region and the product’s alpha.

name: Highlight Bloom
description: A restrained bloom spreads from bright product pixels above a threshold.

name: Echo Trail
description: Fading copies trace the entrance and disappear once the product settles.

name: Film Grain
description: Seeded monochrome texture adds a light photographic finish.

name: Atmosphere
description: Sparse, seeded particles drift behind the product without changing its image.

name: Moving Studio Light
description: A broad pool of light moves across the background behind the product.

name: Background Distortion
description: A gentle wave bends the studio graphics while the product stays rigid.

name: Composed Studio
description: Float, responsive shadow, subtle drift and background light share one clock.

name: Product Anchor
description: An authored point stays on the intact product as it moves.

name: Uniform Scale
description: A gentle push-in around a fixed pivot, preserving product proportions.

name: Rotate
description: A small two-dimensional tilt around the product’s base.

name: Following Callout
description: The label stays still while its connector follows the cap.

name: Detail Window
description: A closer look at the same source pixels, alongside the complete product.

name: Measured Layout
description: Supplied copy fits a bounded type size; the panel follows its measured height.

name: Alpha Matte
description: An independently moving soft mask controls the product’s visibility.

name: Sequence
description: Introduction, feature hold and closing message share one explicit timeline.
